title: Research sprint goal: The query log says why delivery stalls, exports fast, and its open findings are worked
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Open questions for this sprint (kb first, then live docs): No outside facts expected (all inputs are the query log's own data: digest, distill.log, findings); confirm with rag.py pack --root _self and record what kb/_self/querylog.md says on each clause. No outside facts: every clause is about this project's own query log; rag.py pack --root _self (2026-10-20) found the rules in kb/_self docs, not official sources. Redact-gate check message and where the operator's remedy is written: querylog.md Store/Gates (l.151) and Delivery (l.207, apply --push gates the copy with check and the leak scan; a problem commits nothing), tools.md l.124 (check, exit 1); the entry-predates-rules wording is not stated, so the committed item adds it. Delivery alert holds while the last apply --push outcome is refused: monitoring.md l.214 (querylog panel Alert); the usage count once per prompt: usage.md l.89-99 and querylog.md l.97 (a prompt in several windows counts once), the panel's day count via ql_report.usage_today (usage.md l.99). Export --since: querylog.md l.269 and tools.md l.133 say what it prints, not that it reads only the exported days, so the committed item states it. Open rules findings and source findings: backlog.md l.378 (a gap finding is closed by a commit that resolves its _gaps.md entry). Count or list question as a gap: querylog.md l.173 (the Apply gap step writes the _gaps.md entry) names no exclusion, so the committed item adds one. distill.log size cap and parallel-hook feedback ids: querylog.md l.217 names the log's lines, not a size cap or the id race; the pack found none (coverage none), so the committed items document the behaviour they change.
